question_text: Two parallel lists hold competitor IDs and times. Describe bubble-sort steps to put times in ascending order while preserving each ID’s association with its time. Do not write code.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Traverse adjacent pairs of time values in each pass.; Compare the two values.; Swap when the left time is greater than the right.; Swap the corresponding IDs at the same indices.; Repeat passes until no swap occurs/or an equivalent fixed number of passes guarantees sorting.
